content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD MODULE BATHY_CORRECTION_MODULE (L54-287): iterative bathymetry smoothing that caps bottom slope (header L46-47: correct bathy/topo where slope exceeds a threshold, default slope > 1.0). Module data (SAVE, L63): allocatable work arrays Depth0/Depth1/Gradx0/Grady0/Gradx/Grady/Depth_org (L65-66), MASK0 (L67), input parameters SmoothBelowDepth and SlopeCap (L68), PARALLEL-only myvar/myint (L71-72). SUBROUTINE CORRECTION (L77-260): sets pointcount=0, threshold=0.05_SP (L94-95); reads SmoothBelowDepth from input.txt via READ_FLOAT with default -LARGE if absent (L101-104) and SlopeCap with default 1.0_SP (L106-109); logs both to unit 3 and stdout (L112-127); allocates work arrays (L130-133); copies Depth into Depth_org/Depth0/Depth1 and sets MASK0=1 (L136-139); marks MASK0=0 on any cell shallower than SmoothBelowDepth and its four neighbors (L141-151), exchanging MASK0 ghosts via phi_int_exch under PARALLEL (L154); computes initial slope magnitudes Gradx0/Grady0 = |central difference of Depth0| / DX,DY (CARTESIAN scalar L165-166, curvilinear DX(I,J) L168-169) where MASK0==1. Main loop DO WHILE(change_percentage > threshold .AND. pointcount <= 1000) (L177-230): logs iteration and convergence percentage (L180-191), recomputes Gradx/Grady (L198-202), and where MAX(Gradx,Grady) > SlopeCap applies the 5-point smoothing stencil Depth1 = 0.4*Depth0(I,J) + 0.15*(4 neighbors) (L206-207), tracks the max relative change tmp1 = |Depth0-Depth1| / MAX(MinDepthFrc*10_SP, Depth0) into change_percentage (L208-209); exchanges Depth1 ghosts (L218), commits Depth0=Depth1 (L221), increments PointCount (L223) and MPI_ALLREDUCE-maxes change_percentage across ranks (L226-227). After convergence it logs total iteration count (L239-244), writes the smoothed field back to Depth (L248), exchanges ghosts of Depth and gradient arrays (L251-255) and calls OUTPUT_CORRECTION (L258). SUBROUTINE OUTPUT_CORRECTION (L262-285) writes six diagnostic fields to RESULT_FOLDER via PutFile: depth_org.txt (L272-273), depth_change.txt = Depth_org-Depth0 (L274-275), gradx0.txt/grady0.txt (L276-279), gradx.txt/grady.txt (L280-283).
entities: Depth0, Depth1, Gradx0, Grady0, Gradx, Grady, Depth_org ALLOCATABLE REAL(SP)(:,:) (L65-66)
Ifile, ierr, K, K5, K10, K15, pointcount INTEGER (L85)
status, req, nreq, len PARALLEL-only MPI locals (L89-91)
TMP_NAME, FDIR CHARACTER(LEN=80) locals of OUTPUT_CORRECTION (L267-268)

equations.ref: initial slope, CARTESIAN branch (y: L166; curvilinear L168-169)
5-point smoothing stencil, continued L207: +0.15_SP*(4 neighbors); weights sum to 1

io.name: unit 3 and stdout: 'Bathymetry correction ...', SmoothBelowDepth, SlopeCap
unit 3 and stdout: iteration / convergence percentage

verbatim_spans.text: !  bathy_correction_module is a module to correct bathy/topo data if slope exceeds

unresolved: MinDepthFrc*10_SP (L208): the literal 10_SP uses SP as an integer kind parameter although SP is the real kind from PARAM; whether this compiles as intended (integer kind SP) or was meant as 10.0_SP is determined outside this file.

MASK0 masking marks cells with Depth0 < SmoothBelowDepth and their neighbors as 0, i.e. smoothing is applied only to cells DEEPER than SmoothBelowDepth (L143-149); with the default SmoothBelowDepth=-LARGE (L103) nothing is masked. The parameter name suggests 'smooth below this depth' but the code excludes cells below it - intent vs naming unclear from this file alone.

Cross-line: change_percentage is MPI_ALLREDUCE-maxed only under PARALLEL after the increment (L226-227), but the loop-condition check (L177) in the first iteration uses the seeded 1.0_SP (L176); iteration counts printed per rank are consistent only because of the allreduce at loop bottom.

Declared but unused in this file: myint (L72), Ifile, K, K5, K10, K15 (L85), TMP_NAME of CORRECTION (L84), status/req/nreq/len (L89-91, the MPI_WAITALL that used them is commented at L233); itmp1-itmp4, SMALL, tmp2, tmp3 imported at L78 are unused.
Convergence loop cap 'pointcount .LE.1000' (L177) with threshold 0.05 (L95): if not converged by 1001 iterations the capped bathymetry is accepted without warning; no failure flag is set.
Unit 3 is written (L113-115 etc.) but opened elsewhere (LOG file of the main program) - external dependency.
